5358580.desc: 在廢棄太空站裡打撈物資的無重力「見好就收」Roguelite。沒有煞車：推進器消耗氧氣，想停下只能蹬牆，或把貨物往反方向丟。太空站結構每次都不同，配額每 3 次下潛結算一次。儘管貪心，但只有活著帶回氣閘才算錢。最多支援 4 人線上合作。

5347600.name: Crazy City Golf
5347600.desc: The whole city is your golf course! Tee off at once with up to 8 friends in this online party golf game. Find your own route to the cup through alleys and over rooftops in a city rebuilt every round. Summon meteors and tornadoes for shortcuts or sabotage, and turn wild accidents into comebacks!

4924750.name: Village of the Mirror
4924750.desc: A first-person psychological horror set in a forgotten village where Japanese and Anatolian folklore collide. Explore abandoned places, solve puzzles, uncover the past, and cross Torii gates into the afterlife to uncover the truth.

5366400.name: Prism Core
5366400.desc: A neon cyberpunk color-matching survival arcade game. Sync your color with incoming blocks to survive across 3 unique modes. Features active color system, shields, and 15 achievements. Fast-paced score attack gameplay with infinite replayability.
